<parameter=code>
# Try LEFT from current position
result = action(['LEFT'])
print("Result:", result.get('state'), "Done:", result.get('done'))
print("State node:", result.get('state_node_id'))
print("Untried here:", result.get('untried_here'))

# Check player position
seg = current_frame.segmentation
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] == 'b':
        b = n['boundary']
        cr = (min(p[0] for p in b) + max(p[0] for p in b)) // 2
        cc = (min(p[1] for p in b) + max(p[1] for p in b)) // 2
        gr = round((cr - 16) / 3)
        gc = round((cc - 16) / 3)
        print(f"Blue now at grid ({gr}, {gc})")
        break

# Print relevant rows
grid = {}
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['id'] == 0:
        continue
    b = n['boundary']
    cr = (min(p[0] for p in b) + max(p[0] for p in b)) // 2
    cc = (min(p[1] for p in b) + max(p[1] for p in b)) // 2
    gr = round((cr - 16) / 3)
    gc = round((cc - 16) / 3)
    key = (gr, gc)
    if key not in grid or n['pixels'] > grid[key][1]:
        grid[key] = (n['color'], n['pixels'])
grid_colors = {k: v[0] for k, v in grid.items()}

for gr in range(2, 7):
    row_str = ""
    for gc in range(-1, 14):
        if (gr, gc) in grid_colors:
            row_str += grid_colors[(gr, gc)]
        else:
            row_str += "."
    print(f"  {gr}: {row_str}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
